## 🤖 AUTO PROMPT

The Auto Prompt box drives whichever captioners you have installed.
None ship with RedNode and none install automatically. Anything you
skip is simply switched off in the panel, and missing packs print one
console line and are skipped rather than erroring the run.

**Ollama** (recommended, the main one)

- Install Ollama itself, then pull a vision model
- Nothing goes in ComfyUI. RedNode talks to it over HTTP
- The System and Question boxes under the ⚙ control what it is asked

**WD14 tags**

- [comfyui-wd14-tagger](https://github.com/pythongosssss/ComfyUI-WD14-Tagger)
- Fetches its own tagger model on first use

**JoyCaption** (optional, heavy)

**QwenVL** (optional, heavy)

- [ComfyUI-QwenVL](https://github.com/1038lab/ComfyUI-QwenVL)

nodes.title: 🎭 AUTO MASK
widgets_values:
## 🎭 AUTO MASK

Mask background and Mask subject need a segmenter. NO MODEL SHIPS
WITH REDNODE and nothing is downloaded by us. Cut and hand painting
need nothing.

### Install (recommended)

**ComfyUI Manager:** search for `Comfyui-RMBG` and install.

**Or by hand:**

cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes
git clone https://github.com/1038lab/ComfyUI-RMBG

Then install its requirements:

./ComfyUI/python_embeded/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

Restart ComfyUI.

### The model

RMBG-2.0 downloads itself on first use into `ComfyUI/models/RMBG/`.
Nothing to place by hand.

If the automatic download fails, get it from [RMBG-2.0](https://huggingface.co/1038lab/RMBG-2.0) and put the files in

`ComfyUI/models/RMBG/RMBG-2.0/`

⚠️ Windows: if installing the requirements crashes, set `PYTHONUTF8=1`
first, then install again.

### Also works

BiRefNet-General, InSPyReNet, or Impact Pack's person_yolov8m-seg
(lighter, lower quality). RedNode picks RMBG-2.0 first when it can.

**Cut**

- Cuts the masked part out as a PNG with real transparency, into your output folder
- Needs a mask first: paint one, or press Mask background / Mask subject
- No extra install. Only the auto mask buttons need a segmenter

nodes.title: POST FX DEPTH EFFECTS
widgets_values:
## 🌫️ POST FX DEPTH EFFECTS

Depth of field and Haze need a depth map.

- [comfyui_controlnet_aux](https://github.com/Fannovel16/comfyui_controlnet_aux)
brings Depth Anything V2, which RedNode uses to make one for you
- Or wire your own depth map into the node's depth input

Without either, those two effects are skipped and every other
effect still runs.

## 📦 CUSTOM NODES THIS WORKFLOW NEEDS

RedNode Studio itself needs none of these. They are what this particular workflow uses.
Install with ComfyUI Manager, or clone each into `ComfyUI/custom_nodes` and restart.

### Verified links

- [rgthree-comfy](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy)
- [ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts](https://github.com/pythongosssss/ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts)
- [ComfyUI-Easy-Sam3](https://github.com/yolain/ComfyUI-Easy-Sam3)
- [ComfyUI-Krea2T-Enhancer](https://github.com/capitan01R/ComfyUI-Krea2T-Enhancer)
- [ComfyUI-KreaPhoton](https://github.com/Kostik2702/ComfyUI-KreaPhoton)
- [Krea2-BBOX-Prompter](https://github.com/ukr8b3g-cmyk/Krea2-BBOX-Prompter)
- [ComfyUI-Krea-Moodboards](https://github.com/Andro-Meta/ComfyUI-Krea-Moodboards) in Manager as "Krea Moodboards"

### In ComfyUI Manager, search by name

- **ComfyUI-KJNodes** SetNode and GetNode
- **ComfyUI-Easy-Use** easy float, simpleMath, indexAnything
- **comfyui-detail-daemon** DetailDaemonSampler
- **ComfyUI-SeedVR2** the upscaler
- **RES4LYF** ClownsharKSampler
- **ComfyUI Image Saver** Sampler and Scheduler selectors
- **ComfyUI-GGUF** the GGUF CLIP loader
- **crt-nodes** FancyTimer


### Optional, for RedNode Studio features

- [ComfyUI-RMBG](https://github.com/1038lab/ComfyUI-RMBG) auto masks
- [ComfyUI-WD14-Tagger](https://github.com/pythongosssss/ComfyUI-WD14-Tagger) auto prompt tags
- [ComfyUI-JoyCaption](https://github.com/1038lab/ComfyUI-JoyCaption)
- [ComfyUI-QwenVL](https://github.com/1038lab/ComfyUI-QwenVL)
- [comfyui_controlnet_aux](https://github.com/Fannovel16/comfyui_controlnet_aux) depth of field and haze
- **Ollama** installed and running, for LLM captioning

### Not needed

TextGenerate and CustomCombo are core ComfyUI. Nothing to install.

You are an image prompt engineer. Your task is to produce a single, optimized image generation prompt.

You may receive:
- An image (analyze its style, composition, subject, lighting, and mood)
- A base prompt from the user (use it as the creative direction)
- Both (blend the visual analysis with the user's intent)
- Neither (generate a vivid, creative prompt on your own)


Rules:
- Do NOT describe the image conversationally.
- Output ONLY a prompt suitable for an image generation model.
- Avoid extra sentences like "Here is..."
- Include NSFW descriptins if aplicable.

1. Subject description:
- Identify and explicitly state the ethnicity and age immediately
- Body proportions (highly important)
- Facial features, skin texture, expression, gaze direction.
- Hair style, hair color, accessories, jewlery, etc.
- Clothing, materials, fit, layers

- Body pose, hand position, posture.
- Framing (close-up, medium shot, full body)

3. Environment and background:
- Location type (studio, indoor, outdoor)
- Background color, texture, objects

4. Lighting:
- Light direction, softness, contrast

5. Artistic and technical style:
- Photorealistic, cinematic, illustration, anime, 3D render, etc.
- Lens look (wide, portrait compression), bokeh if visible
- Image sharpness, noise, realism level

6. Color and mood:
- Dominant colors
- Color grading (warm, cool, neutral, muted, vibrant)

Formatting rules:
- Output as a single, highly descriptive paragraph of natural, dense prose.
- Use concrete, reproducible descriptors.
